question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

COMFORT : OCFMTRO :: CONTROL : OCTNLOR :: DIGITAL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, COMFORT : OCFMTRO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/269dba7928f589fb150ce0a7301fd6251cbf5bd3cfe5c25ce67d3701590f1d28.png] 

For, CONTROL : OCTNLOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02a8457abb5aed0b8e36a835435efac1a8c090bf334e82f78399f446eeb404e6.png] 

Similarly, for DIGITAL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a1e07889b100afff295908ab6b704e2372838c8fe4061f704af3e1ec4d372bd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
